title: Russo-Persian War (1826–1828)
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Russo-Persian War (1826–1828)", at revision 1370729271, opens: "The Russo-Persian War of 1826–1828 was the last major military conflict between the Russian Empire and Qajar Iran, which was fought over territorial disputes in the South Caucasus region." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q1420115, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "last major armed conflict between the Russian Empire and Qajar Iran". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
